name: Conkers
description: Two phones, two conkers, one swing at a time. A conker is a nut cell and a string cell, both LINEAR, locked in a BSV UTXO under SIGHASH_NONE|ANYONECANPAY|CHRONICLE. Properties derive from a hash chain over a fixed issuer signature (spec/genesis.md). Damage is settled by the match record both players sign; the chain enforces that each conker is consumed once per match.

cellTypes.name: conkers.nut
cellTypes.description: The nut: serial, genesis pair id, mass, volume, hardness, elasticity, owner, hp, wins, losses. LINEAR so a nut is struck once per match and cannot be duplicated or dropped.

serial.description: u32 LE. purchase serial, the genesis input

pairId.description: 32-byte hex. h0 = sha256(S || serial): links nut and string

wins.description: u16 LE. matches this nut won

losses.description: u16 LE. matches this nut lost

generation.description: u32 LE. successor count, 0 at mint

issuer.description: 33-byte hex. issuer pubkey the genesis signature verifies under

genesisSig.description: 64-byte hex. compact r||s RFC 6979 signature over CONKERS-GENESIS-v1

cellTypes.name: conkers.string
cellTypes.description: The string: serial, genesis pair id, length, strength, elasticity, owner, intact. LINEAR for the same reason as the nut; a snapped string is a cell whose successor has intact=false.

serial.description: u32 LE. same serial as the nut

pairId.description: 32-byte hex. same h0 as the nut

generation.description: u32 LE. successor count, 0 at mint

genesisSig.description: 64-byte hex. compact signature, same as the nut

cellTypes.name: conkers.player
cellTypes.description: A person's record, keyed by cert-id: challenges, withdrawals, stalls. Lives on the player, never on a conker, so selling a conker does not launder a flincher.

certId.description: 32-byte hex. the person, by BRC-52 cert id; never a conker

challenges.description: u32 LE. turns faced as target

withdrawals.description: u32 LE. turns withdrawn from as target

stalls.description: u32 LE. turns never swung as striker

lastMatchId.description: 32-byte hex. most recent conkers.match cell hash

cellTypes.name: conkers.swing
cellTypes.description: One turn: striker IMU trace summary, target Doppler reading, score, damage. Signed by both phones. Never persisted beyond the match.

matchId.description: 32-byte hex. the match this turn belongs to

imuSpeedCmps.description: u16 LE. striker IMU speed at impact, cm/s

dopplerSpeedCmps.description: u16 LE. target Doppler radial speed, cm/s

planeDeg.description: u8 LE. gravity vs swing plane, degrees

twistDegps.description: u16 LE. peak gyro roll, deg/s

timingMs.description: i16 LE. impact minus target rest, ms

followThrough.description: u8 LE. 1 decelerated after impact, 0 braked before

scoreBp.description: u16 LE. swing score, basis points 0..10000

damageStriker.description: u16 LE. hp lost by the striker nut

damageTarget.description: u16 LE. hp lost by the target nut

snapped.description: u8 LE. bit0 striker string snapped, bit1 target string snapped

timestamp.description: u64 LE. unix ms at impact, striker clock

strikerSig.description: 64-byte hex. striker signature over bytes [0..timestamp end)

targetSig.description: 64-byte hex. target signature over the same bytes

cellTypes.name: conkers.withdraw
cellTypes.description: The target pulled away, or the striker never swung (stall). Signed by both phones or ruled by the arbiter.

reason.description: u8 LE. 1 target withdrew, 2 striker stalled

byCert.description: 32-byte hex. whose record this lands on

sigBy.description: 64-byte hex. signature of the party it counts against

arbiterSig.description: 64-byte hex. zero unless the arbiter ruled

cellTypes.name: conkers.match
cellTypes.description: The match: both nonces exchanged over ggwave (co-location proof), the turn list, final damage, winner. Both players sign, the arbiter countersigns. What resolve consumes.

nonceA.description: u32 LE. sent by A over ggwave, heard and signed by B

nonceB.description: u32 LE. sent by B over ggwave, heard and signed by A

turns.description: u16 LE. number of swing + withdraw cells

turnsRoot.description: 32-byte hex. sha256 chain over the turn cells in order

hpA.description: u16 LE. nut A hp after the match

hpB.description: u16 LE. nut B hp after the match

intactA.description: u8 LE. string A intact after the match

intactB.description: u8 LE. string B intact after the match

sigB.description: 64-byte hex. B over the same bytes

arbiterSig.description: 64-byte hex. arbiter over the same bytes

capabilities.name: cap.conkers.play
capabilities.description: Authorises mint / pair / swing / withdraw / resolve / transfer.

_notes.domainFlag: 0 is a placeholder until a capability page is allocated.
_notes.sighash: 0xE2 = NONE|ANYONECANPAY|CHRONICLE|FORKID. OTDA digest; FORKID is mandatory on sv-node 1.2.2. See spec/lock.md.
_notes.extension: Shape follows vendor/semantos-core/docs/design/WORLD-BASE-LAYER.md §5.1; the client contract is packages/world-client/src/extension.ts.
